headline: Interest-free loans up to 50 thousand euros and limits on rents: Spain advances 21 housing measures
summary: Spain's Council of Ministers approved 21 housing measures, including interest-free loans of up to €50,000 and limits on rents. The decrees differ from earlier texts that Congress rejected.
why: Housing policy affects construction activity, mortgage demand and rental income for property investors in Spain.
